title: SAML 2.0 handshake-resolver + admin diagnostics checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a resilient SAML 2.0 setup flow focused on metadata handshake recovery, actionable admin diagnostics, and audit log events that make troubleshooting and compliance straightforward. Scope includes: 1) a non-blocking metadata ingest that performs layered validation (schema, cert checks, entity id match, endpoints), 2) a deterministic fallback strategy when an IdP provides malformed or partial metadata, 3) admin-facing diagnostics (request/response snippets, fingerprint diff, clock skew hints), 4) RBAC v2 mapping guidance hooks that surface potential authorization gaps during setup, and 5) audit log entries for every exchange and decision point in the flow.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata ingest accepts XML from URL/upload and runs three validation stages: well-formed XML, SAML schema conformance, and certificate/chain verification.
When validation fails, UI surfaces a single prioritized fix suggestion with an expandable diagnostic panel (curlable SAML request/response, certificate PEM, SHA1/SHA256 fingerprints).

Automatic retry/fallback: if the IdP metadata URL returns transient HTTP 5xx or single endpoint missing, the flow will retry 3x with exponential backoff and then allow an admin to provide a manual endpoint override without losing current partial config.
RBAC v2 hints: based on SAML attribute mapping, the assistant indicates whether existing role mappings would grant admin privileges and warns if the mapping is too permissive.
Audit logs: every metadata fetch/validation result, manual override, and rollout decision is emitted to the audit log stream with standardized fields (actor, timestamp, event_type, details).
E2E tests cover IdP fixtures: good metadata, expired cert, missing ACS, invalid signature, clock skew +/- 10m, and partial endpoint lists; all fixtures pass or return expected validation messages.
Performance: setup flow must finish initial validations under 1.2s for cached metadata and under 4s for live fetch + validation on reasonable networks (50ms RTT).
progress_updates: 2025-02-13: Spike completed — implemented prototype metadata parser using xmlsec for signature verification. Found intermittent failures when metadata includes multiple KeyDescriptors; added selection heuristic based on Use attribute.
2025-02-18: Design sync with UX — decided against blocking the entire flow on a missing optional endpoint; instead show a "Continue with manual override" CTA and flag as degraded in audit.
2025-02-21: Security review prelim — flagged certificate chain validation edge case for self-signed intermediate certs. Assigned to ENG-62345 for CA path resolution improvements.
2025-02-24: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/security/pull/214 — metadata parser + validation pipeline. Added unit tests for XML namespace variations discovered in vendor metadata.
2025-02-27: QA run — found a UX race when retry backoff triggers while admin edits manual endpoint. Added critical-section lock in the console flow and updated acceptance tests.
2025-03-01: Implemented audit payload schema and wired events to internal event-log service. Next: add RBAC hint rules and finalize console copy.
qa_plan: Run E2E harness with IdP fixture set (fixtures stored in drive: //redwood-security/fixtures/saml-2025).
Manual exploratory: simulate slow metadata host (2000ms) and verify fallback CTA and audit events.
Pen test: deliver malformed metadata with unicode eol and verify XML parser rejects and logs event without leaking PII.
Regression: run existing SSO onboarding regression suite.
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind 'sso.handshake_resolver' flag. Canary: enable for 5% tenants for 48h with verbose logging. If no critical errors, expand to 50% for 72h; then general availability. Have rollback plan to disable new validation and fall back to legacy ingest for 1 hour windows.
open_questions: Should we persist raw metadata in audit logs or store only fingerprints? Security team prefers fingerprints + short-lived raw blob; legal wants 90-day retention on raw for compliance — need trade-off decision.
What is the exact RBAC v2 rule set to run during onboarding? We need product input on role naming conventions to produce useful hints.
Backup fetch strategy for metadata behind auth: do we ask admins to provide a bearer token or support Basic auth on fetch?
notes: Keep messaging concise for non-technical admins; provide an advanced panel for operators. Coordinate with infra on allowing retriable fetches without exhausting IdP rate limits. Ensure all emitted audit events have schema versioning to support future migrations.
